name: Whitehorse Meadows Farm
description: In 302 State Route 530 NE, WA, Whitehorse Meadows Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on an independent apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
